levels.source: row.user_id -> tenant (best-effort; may remain NULL for system events)

per_table_contract.conceptual_query: UPDATE t SET tenant_id = derive(t) WHERE tenant_id IS NULL AND <batch predicate>
per_table_contract.idempotency: WHERE tenant_id IS NULL guarantees idempotency
per_table_contract.shadow_validation: count rows without tenant before vs after; compare per-user distributions
per_table_contract.orphan_handling: row remains tenant_id=NULL; enters quarantine_orphans (conceptual) for human review
per_table_contract.ambiguous_handling: NEVER auto-assign; write to quarantine_ambiguous (conceptual) with all candidate tenants
per_table_contract.rollback: UPDATE t SET tenant_id = NULL for rows tagged in backfill_batch table
